title: GTD Inbox Entry
description: One line of the GTD inbox log (append-then-flip). This file defines the SHAPE only; the SEMANTICS (capture discipline, triage lifecycle) live in flow-inbox. Minified, one JSON object per line.

schema_version.description: Contract version; pinned so a consumer can detect a shape change. The log is durable and may outlive a revision, so every line carries the version it was written under.

id.description: UTC-stamp + random suffix; time-prefixed so `sort` is chronological.

text.description: VERBATIM. Never summarized/reformatted at capture time.

project.description: basename of the capture cwd (repo root). Omitted when not derivable.

is_processed.description: false on capture; flipped by process.sh. Naturally reversible.

note.description: Agent prose written at process time: what became of the item. null until processed.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id that captured this entry (UUID). OMITTED (never null, matching the `project` precedent) for entries captured before session-id enrichment.

processed_ts.description: UTC instant (ISO-8601) the entry was flipped to processed. OMITTED (never null) until processed; removed again on --unprocess.

examples.text: turn the operator + pm into a local MCP server
